name: Data grid
desc: A searchable, sortable table that fills the window, a filter, a details panel beside it that follows the picked row, adding a record and exporting to CSV.

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Records
windows.menus:
&File
    &Add a record | Ctrl+N | AddRecord()
    &Export as CSV... | Ctrl+E | ExportCsv()
    -
    E&xit | Alt+F4 | g.Close()
windows.status:
msg | Click a row to see it; double-click to change its score | grow icon=E80A
rows | 12 rows | w=100 right
windows.flows:
addBtn Click -> call AddRecord
exportBtn Click -> call ExportCsv
windows.hotkeys:
^n | active | own | AddRecord
^e | active | own | ExportCsv
windows.script:
; The panel beside the grid: the picked person, or a word about picking one. ShowPerson(p) { global g if !IsObject(p) return g.Html("detail", '
Pick someone in the list.
') E := (s) => AxTags.E(String(s)) g.Html("detail", '
' E(p.name) '
' . '
Team' E(p.team) '
' . '
City' E(p.city) '
' . '
Status' E(p.status) '
' . '
With us since' E(p.since) '
' . '
' . '
Score' E(p.score) ' / 100
') } AddRecord() { global g, grid name := Trim(g.Prompt("Who is it?", "Add a record", "", "Full name")) if (name = "") return rows := grid.Component.Rows rows.Push({Key: "p" A_TickCount, name: name, team: "Engineering", city: "", status: "Active", since: FormatTime(, "yyyy"), score: 50}) grid.SetRows(rows) g.Status("rows", rows.Length " rows") g.Toast("Added " name, 1500, "success") } ExportCsv() { global g, grid f := FileSelect("S16", A_MyDocuments "\records.csv", "Export as CSV", "CSV (*.csv)") if (f = "") return q := (s) => '"' StrReplace(String(s), '"', '""') '"' out := "Name,Team,City,Status,Since,Score`n" for r in grid.Component.Rows out .= q(r.name) "," q(r.team) "," q(r.city) "," q(r.status) "," r.since "," r.score "`n" try FileDelete(f) FileAppend(out, f, "UTF-8") g.Toast("Exported " grid.Component.Rows.Length " rows", 2000, "success") }
